_comment: Starter electrical pricebook catalog for new founder tenants (DB-MGMT-1, design §F.5). Content gated on Tom's sign-off before first prod use. ~12 items covering common electrical contractor services and materials.

items.name: Standard Outlet Install
items.description: Install or replace a standard 15A/20A duplex receptacle, including box and cover plate.

items.name: Light Fixture Replacement
items.description: Remove existing fixture and install a new light fixture (LED recessed, surface, or pendant).

items.name: Switch Replacement
items.description: Replace a single-pole or 3-way switch, including plate cover.

items.name: 200A Panel Upgrade
items.description: Upgrade main service panel to 200A, including panel, main breaker, and grounding. Permit and inspection included.

items.name: Troubleshooting — 1 Hour Minimum
items.description: Diagnostic service call to identify electrical issue. 1-hour minimum, billed in 15-min increments thereafter.

items.name: Ceiling Fan Install
items.description: Install a ceiling fan in an existing junction box, including balancing and remote pairing.

items.name: EV Charger Install (Level 2)
items.description: Install a Level 2 EV charger (240V/40A circuit), including breaker, wiring, and mounting. Charger hardware not included.

items.name: 15A Single-Pole Breaker
items.description: Square D QO or equivalent 15A single-pole circuit breaker.

items.name: 20A Single-Pole Breaker
items.description: Square D QO or equivalent 20A single-pole circuit breaker.

items.name: 1" EMT Conduit
items.description: 1-inch EMT (Electrical Metallic Tubing) conduit, per linear foot.

items.name: 12/2 Romex NM-B Wire
items.description: 12 AWG 2-conductor with ground NM-B copper wire, per foot.

items.name: Wire Nuts — Assorted Bag
items.description: Assorted bag of twist-on wire connectors (yellow/red/orange), 100 count.

items.name: Permit Fee — Standard
items.description: Standard electrical permit fee for residential work. Tax-exempt (pass-through cost).
